title: Young-Renter Charge Amount on a Rental Vehicle Coordination Rental
content:
**Charge.** The young-renter charge on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, owed by a renter who is young at pickup (no older than the class's highest age for the young-renter fee) and booked as one customer charge of the final invoice once the rental is returned, is the class young-renter fee for every rental day, rounded to the cent. It is always the customer's, and it is booked for those rental days as the days it covers.

Rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Pickup date and time, return date and time | The reservation |
| Class young-renter fee per rental day | The class specification sheet, for the class rented |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- A Compact Rental (young-renter fee 25.00 USD per rental day) picked up on the 5th at 10:00 and returned on the 9th at 12:00: 4 whole days between the dates and a later return time, so 5 rental days. The charge is 5 days at 25.00 USD, 125.00 USD, booked as covering 5 days.
- A Standard SUV Rental (fee 30.00 USD) picked up on the 5th at 10:00 and returned on the 9th at 09:00: 4 rental days, a charge of 120.00 USD covering 4 days.

## Quick table (hypothetical lengths)

| Rental days | Charge at 25.00 USD per day | Charge at 30.00 USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 25.00 USD | 30.00 USD |
| 3 | 75.00 USD | 90.00 USD |
| 8 | 200.00 USD | 240.00 USD |
